prompt.project_info: Create a cinematic editorial portrait using long exposure and intentional motion trails against a near-black background.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional woman in a deep maroon flowing dress, side profile with head slightly lowered, introspective distant expression, seated with relaxed hands in lap.
prompt.composition_elements: Portrait framing with a sharp central profile and translucent ghosted echoes flowing around the silhouette; near-black minimal background, crimson and ruby palette.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Low-key red-gel lighting, deep heavy shadows, soft haze and film grain, melancholic cinematic atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm film look, long exposure, shutter drag, stroboscopic motion blur, double-exposure blend, sharp core features with softened edges.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Cinematic 35mm editorial portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman in a deep maroon flowing dress, seated in side profile with head slightly lowered and hands relaxed in her lap, long-exposure shutter drag creating crimson motion trails and ghosted echoes around her, near-black background, low-key red-gel light, deep shadows, soft haze, film grain, sharp central profile, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, text, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: crimson ghost portrait reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Match the maroon dress, side profile, seated posture, red motion trails, black background and film texture; keep identity and motion pattern replaceable.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the reference image. Keep the mood, dress silhouette and double-exposure treatment consistent; use a clearly adult fictional identity and replaceable motion echoes.
